markers.slow: Excluded from the default fast command. scheduled-suite.yml inventories and partitions every slow node in both root and legacy suites; the older optional ci.yml smoke job retains its bounded legacy regression scope.
markers.frontend: Collected from tests/refactor and tests/runtime by frontend CI after npm ci; other jobs exclude this marker.
markers.requires_clean_core: Skipped only when bound src/solarlab Python files are changed or Git provenance is unavailable; clean CI runs the test.
markers.platform_bound: Explicit captured-fixture consumer inventory; does not skip tests. Only locally regenerated floating outputs compared with historical words require a capture-environment guard; portable metadata and live parity remain unconditional.

optional_dependencies.arb: python-flint==0.8.0 is locked and installed in core CI; local tests requiring it skip explicitly when absent.
optional_dependencies.ida: scikit-sundae==1.1.3 is locked and installed in core CI; the five original failing IDA cases run as strict xfails.
optional_dependencies.uv: The packages job installs pinned uv; isolated release installation tests skip with a reason when uv is absent locally.

scan_execution.reason: Pool RSS includes the pytest parent process family; importing all numerical/runtime modules first exhausts the unchanged per-job budgets. Run this file once in its own pytest process and ignore it only in bulk discovery.

supervisor_control_failure.reason: The real 768 MiB supervisor budget charges the pytest process family. Bulk runtime imports can exhaust it and stop the barrier child before control-failure injection; run these recovery contracts once in a fresh process with unchanged RSS and sampling limits.

run_client.reason: The supervised browser client uses the existing bounded pool; broad schema/runtime collection retains unrelated numerical modules in the parent. Run this file once in its own pytest process with unchanged RSS limits.
